why_it_moved.text: The mechanism is unknown: the scorecard has no segment cuts, and its change columns disagree with each other, so no effect size can be trusted yet.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: Re-export the scorecard with the percent-change column in one consistent unit, matching the absolute change divided by the control mean, then rerun the decision.
Add a pre-exposure comparison and a daily series by days since first exposure, so the pre-period and novelty checks can run.
